collections.title: Collections
collections.body: All your open and recently used collections appear here. Click one to view its schema, documents, and run queries.

collectionActions.title: Create or Open
collectionActions.body: Use + to create a new collection from scratch, or the arrow button to open an existing collection directory from disk.

embeddings.title: Embedding Functions
embeddings.body: Register embedding models (local ONNX, OpenAI, Qwen, etc.) that auto-vectorize your text on insert and query.

rerankers.title: Reranker Functions
rerankers.body: Set up rerankers (RRF, Weighted, or model-based) to improve search relevance by re-scoring initial results.

workspace.title: Collection Workspace
workspace.body: Open a collection and you will see four tabs: Overview for schema and index management, Browse for filtering and inspecting documents, Query for running vector similarity searches, and Write for inserting, upserting, or deleting documents.

home.heading: 👋 Welcome to Zvec Studio
home.subheading: Create a new Collection or open an existing one to get started.

collections.title: Collections
collections.subtitle: Create, open and manage local Zvec Collections.
collections.placeholder: Create or open a Collection to inspect schema, browse documents, and run queries.

empty.title: No Collection yet
empty.body: Create your first Collection or open an existing one from disk.

list.deleteConfirmBody: This closes and removes "{{name}}" from the open registry. On-disk data is not touched.

create.title: Create Collection
create.name: Collection name
create.nameHelp: 3-64 chars, must start with a letter; letters, digits and underscores.
create.pathHelp: Absolute path to a directory that does NOT exist yet — Zvec will create it. Tip: pick the parent directory with Browse, the Collection name will be appended automatically.
create.pathBrowseHint: Will create at {{parent}}/{{name}} — edit the path manually to override.
create.pathBrowseHintNoName: Picked parent {{parent}}. Fill in the Collection name above and the path will auto-complete.
create.pathUnsupported: This browser cannot open a directory picker. In the desktop app you can click Browse…; otherwise type the absolute path the backend can reach.
create.pathBrowserNotice: Browsers can only see the directory name ("{{name}}"), not its absolute path. Please type the full path below so the backend can write the Collection there.
create.fieldsHelp: Optional metadata fields (title, category, price…). The primary key (`id`) is managed by Zvec — do not declare it.
create.primaryInfo: Zvec injects a string primary key (`id`) for every document automatically.

errors.nameFormat: Name must match ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{3,64}$ (3-64 chars, letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens).
errors.pathAbsolute: Please provide an absolute path (starting with / on macOS/Linux or a drive letter on Windows).
errors.dimRange: Dimension must be an integer between 1 and 32768.
errors.fieldsRequired: Add at least one vector or scalar field.
errors.fieldNameRequired: Each field needs a valid name.
errors.duplicateField: Field name "{{name}}" is used more than once — each field must have a unique name.
errors.invalidIndexParams: Index params must be a JSON object.

hints.idColumn: Naming a column "id" is allowed. This collection's primary key will then be shown and exchanged under "$id" to avoid the clash.

open.title: Open Collection
open.pathHelp: Absolute path to an existing Collection directory.
open.pathUnsupported: This browser cannot open a directory picker. In the desktop app you can click Browse…; otherwise type the absolute path the backend can reach.
open.pathBrowserNotice: Browsers can only see the directory name ("{{name}}"), not its absolute path. Please type the full path below.

addFieldDialog.title: Add scalar field
addFieldDialog.nameHelp: Identifier-like; will not affect existing rows except via expression.
addFieldDialog.expressionHelp: Zvec expression used to populate the new column for existing rows. Leave blank to use the dtype's zero value.

renameFieldDialog.title: Rename field "{{name}}"
renameFieldDialog.newNameHelp: Identifier-like. The change is applied immediately on disk.

errors.sameName: New name must differ from the current one.

dropFieldDialog.title: Drop field "{{name}}"?
dropFieldDialog.body: This permanently removes the scalar column "{{name}}" and all of its values. This cannot be undone.

errors.invalidParams: Index params must be a JSON object.
errors.noVectorFields: This Collection has no vector fields.

createScalarIndexDialog.title: Create scalar index on "{{field}}"
createScalarIndexDialog.hint: Use INVERT for scalar filters or FTS for full-text search on STRING fields.

dropScalarIndexDialog.title: Drop scalar index on "{{field}}"?
dropScalarIndexDialog.body: This removes the INVERT index on "{{field}}". Scalar filtering will fall back to full scan.

dropIndexDialog.title: Drop index for "{{vectorField}}"?
dropIndexDialog.body: This removes the vector index on "{{vectorField}}". Existing data is kept; subsequent searches must rebuild the index.

placeholder.viz: The 2D projection playground is on the post-MVP roadmap. Use the Documents and Search tabs for now.

import.title: Import documents from file
import.fileHelp: A JSONL file — one JSON document per line. The file is read from this machine. To import a whole collection from a snapshot (.tar.gz), use Collections → Import Collection.
import.modeReplace: Upsert (insert new ids, overwrite existing ones)
import.modeReplaceHelp: New ids are inserted; existing ids are replaced by the file's content as a whole document (fields absent from the file are cleared). Re-importing the same file gives the same result.
import.modeInsert: Insert only (fail rows whose id already exists)
import.onErrorAbort: Abort at the first failing row
import.abortedInsert: Import stopped at the first error. Documents before the failing row were imported.
import.abortedReplace: Import stopped at the first error. Documents before the failing row were imported; in replace mode, some documents right after it may also have been written.

export.title: Export documents
export.modeHelp: A snapshot bundles the schema with the data so the collection can be recreated elsewhere.
export.includeVectorHelp: Uncheck to omit vector data from the file — it shrinks a lot.
export.fieldsHelp: Select specific scalar fields, or leave all unchecked to export every field.
export.startedBody: Your download has begun — check the browser's download area.
export.maintenanceHint: Reads and writes stay available during the export; maintenance (index creation, optimize, …) is briefly rejected until it finishes.
export.includeFieldsHelp: Checked: scalar fields are exported — optionally pick specific ones below (none picked = all). Unchecked: only the primary key and vectors are exported.
export.nothingSelectedWarning: Neither vectors nor scalar fields are selected: the file will contain only primary keys.
export.snapshotFullDataHint: To trim data, switch to Data file.

importCollection.title: Import Collection
importCollection.fileHelp: A snapshot produced by Export → Collection snapshot: schema and data bundled together.
importCollection.targetHelp: The imported collection is created here. Defaults to a directory next to the snapshot file — editable. Must be a path that does not exist yet.
importCollection.nameHelp: Defaults to the name recorded in the snapshot; rename to avoid a clash.
importCollection.namePlaceholder: Leave empty to keep the snapshot's name

errors.required: Both the snapshot file and the target directory are required.

0.title: Create or open a Collection
0.body: Collections hold your vectors and scalar fields. Use the sidebar to create a new collection or open an existing directory from disk.

1.title: Schema & Index management
1.body: In the Overview tab you can inspect and modify your collection schema. Add or rename scalar fields, create vector indexes (HNSW, IVF_FLAT) and scalar indexes (INVERT) — all from the inline Actions column.

2.title: Browse and write documents
2.body: Use the Browse tab to filter and inspect documents with Zvec expressions, and the Write tab to insert, upsert or delete rows — with form-based or raw JSON input.

3.title: Run vector searches
3.body: The Query tab lets you run top-K nearest-neighbour queries. Paste a query vector, optionally add a filter, and view results ranked by similarity score.

4.title: Embeddings & Rerankers
4.body: Register embedding and reranker functions from the sidebar. These AI functions can auto-vectorize text on insert and re-rank search results for better relevance.

code.COLLECTION_ALREADY_EXISTS: Conflicts with an already-open Collection's name or path. Close it first or pick another name / path.
code.DIMENSION_MISMATCH: Vector dimension does not match the Collection schema.
code.AI_DEPENDENCY_MISSING: AI extensions are not installed. Run `make install.ai` to enable embedding/reranking.
code.AI_FUNCTION_NOT_FOUND: The specified AI function does not exist.
code.AI_FUNCTION_ALREADY_EXISTS: An AI function with this name already exists.
code.AI_FUNCTION_INVOCATION_FAILED: AI function invocation failed. Check model config or network.
code.VALIDATION_ERROR: Request validation failed. Please check your input.
code.INTERNAL_ERROR: Internal server error. Please retry or inspect logs.
code.DOCUMENT_CONFLICT: A document with this primary key already exists.
code.INVALID_DOCUMENT: The document does not match the collection schema.
code.IMPORT_FILE_NOT_FOUND: The import file was not found.
code.IMPORT_FILE_NOT_READABLE: The import file cannot be read. Check its permissions.
code.IMPORT_MANIFEST_INVALID: The snapshot package is not a readable archive or has an invalid manifest.
code.IMPORT_SCHEMA_MISMATCH: The snapshot schema is not compatible with this collection. Close it first or pick a compatible collection.
code.EXPORT_BLOCKED: Export cannot start right now. Close other exports and retry.
code.EXPORT_NON_FINITE_VALUE: A document contains NaN/Infinity and cannot be exported to JSON.
code.MAINTENANCE_BLOCKED: Blocked while an export is running. Retry after the export finishes.
code.UNSUPPORTED_VECTOR_DATA_TYPE: This collection uses a vector data type this Studio version does not support.
